tasks.label: ci: benches all targets (locked)
tasks.command: rustup run stable cargo check --manifest-path benches/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked

tasks.label: ci: fuzz all targets
tasks.command: rustup run stable cargo check --manifest-path fuzz/Cargo.toml --all-targets

tasks.label: test: websocket under 2 CPUs (CI runner shape)
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Process -Id $PID).ProcessorAffinity = 3; rustup run 1.78.0 cargo test --test ws"

tasks.label: bench: websocket vs tungstenite/tokio-tungstenite
tasks.command: rustup run stable cargo bench --manifest-path benches/Cargo.toml --bench ws

tasks.label: bench: complexity (time and space, vs tungstenite/reqwest)
tasks.command: rustup run stable cargo bench --manifest-path benches/Cargo.toml --bench complexity
